notes.title: SKIPCHASER 1.5 is live!
notes.content:
In celebration of our new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302440/RogueJack_Roguelike_Blackjack/]RogueJack[/url] releasing on Steam a couple of days ago, we've packaged up some QoE updates for SKIPCHASER and added a few new features.

Here's the breakdown of whats new:
[list]
    [*]Sliding difficulty scale that buff enemies the less you die 
    [*]In-level vending machines that let you try out some of the weapon parts for a limited time
    [*]64-bit and signing issues on macOS
    [*]Keep bosses from blowing themselves up
    [*]Missile bullets?!?!?!
    [*]Various Steelseries keyboard fixes
[/list]

We've also added [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302440/RogueJack_Roguelike_Blackjack/]RogueJack[/url] to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15142/Ponywolf_Franchise/]Ponywolf Franchise bundle[/url], so if you supported us in the past you can get our new game for an even deeper discount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27821198/813c96aacc22959c5741c89bf09388cd43f4d050.png[/img]

Thanks for playing and supporting Ponywolf

tags.feature: [*]Sliding difficulty scale that buff enemies the less you die
[*]In-level vending machines that let you try out some of the weapon parts for a limited time

notes.title: Happy Halloween! 25% off and new updates in BETA!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween Sale steamers! We're 25% off until November 1st AND we pushed a few gameplay balancing features and added a new enemy type--the spider mine.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/d4a36bbaee8c7e4db665368108e1a2373d9f2764.gif[/img]

Here's a list of what's new:

[list]
[*] Long overdue SDK update
[*] Rats run away for 1s after hitting you and have less health
[*] Small enemies are a bit easier to hit
[*] CRIMELORD doesn't disappear erroneously
[*] CRIMELORD scene floor color is changed for better contrast with bullets
[*] Added spider mines to some of the level 5 and 7 levels
[*] "Empty" chests now give some gold instead
[*]  EXPERIMENTAL gun elements, bullet multipliers, and bullet types (missiles and lasers too) working
[/list]

To try these new features out, you'll need to get the BETA branch of SKIPCHASER by going into the properties of the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/b271885bd2fa3debc0934553665c4ff8fe062381.png[/img]

notes.title: SKIPCHASER 1.0 Hotfix pushed
notes.content:
Thanks to user @Alpherior we found a few bugs that made their way into the 1.0 release...

[list]
    [*]Early Access users skipped the final boss level & endless mode
    [*]Small Plasma mag and small Frozen Mag had same image, and same stats

notes.title: SKIPCHASER Released!!!
notes.content:

notes.title: Final Boss Battle Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
As we progress on various updates this summer, we'd really like to put a bow on Skipchaser in it's current form. So, to that end we're going to implement all the levels we have by fleshing out the town, dropping in the final boss battle and wrapping up the storyline.

So, this should come as good news to everyone who wanted to see Skipchaser completed as a stand-alone twin stick shooter/rogue-lke. We can't put an exact day on it, but things are pretty much content complete outside of a few effects and dialog passes.

notes.title: Work continues on SKIPCHASER Update #5
notes.content:
We wrapped the Ludum Dare game jam a couple of weeks ago and are back at SKIPCHASER Update #5. Almost half-way to the full release. Act 1 polish and the stat of Act 2 content is on the way, as well as a few new features including the Armor Workbench...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/8c7c4150619b1e75a20141ab8ce571640825ce9b.png[/img]

No promises on how much of this will get pulled into the next release, but we're excited to keep the ball rolling. We also getting a decent ammount of feedback on what we can be doing better, so keep the bug/feature reports coming.

If you can't wait for this next release, check out our free jam game [url=https://ponywolf.itch.io/flatearths]Flat Earths[/url] for a little multiplayer action...

[url=https://ponywolf.itch.io/flatearths][img]http://i.imgur.com/bJKpIJZ.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: SKIPCHASER Early Access Update 4 Live
notes.content:
Not much to say. Oh wait, we added a whole new mechanic called "skipping." It's a bullet-time effect that allows you to teleport into a local space nearby the player. You can hold the "skip" as long as you want to plan your next course of action. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/STcTtLT.gif[/img]

Also, as usual we've added more content...
[list]
    [*]Updated particle systems
    [*]Skip transition effect
    [*]Auto-frameskipping for slower systems
    [*]DOOM-like face damage in HUD
    [*]Weapon re-balancing
    [*]Ability to stun enemies
    [*]...and much, much more
[/list]

Have fun, and as always feedback in the forums helps us make the game better.

notes.title: Preview SKIPCHASER Early Access Update 4
notes.content:
We are putting the finishing touches on SKIPCHASER's Update #4. We've done quite a bit of rebalancing, bug fixes and added a new gameplay twist. "Skipping" is an ability to slow time to a crawl and hop to a new position close on the map. It's an *beta* feature for sure, so feedback is welcome.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/eGBy1nT.gif[/img]

This feature replaces the little used "jump" and uses what was the "shield" energy that wasn't explained very well. I hope this gets the difficulty balancing back on track so we can focus on fresh content in Update 5.

Speaking of Update 5, there are a raft of things that didn't get ready for Update 4 that are still in the works for a future update
[list]
    [*]Act 1 finale
    [*]GameJolt launch
    [*]Updated SFX/Ambient sound 
    [*]New save format
    [*]PS4 Controller support
    [*]3 new music tracks and OST DLC
[/list]

tags.feature: "Skipping" is an ability to slow time to a crawl and hop to a new position close on the map.

tags.balance_change: I hope this gets the difficulty balancing back on track so we can focus on fresh content in Update 5.

notes.title: SKIPCHASER Early Access Update 3
notes.content:
It's all about weapons and bugs in Update #3. We cleared out every open issue on the forums and exposed quite a bit more of the weapons workbench. If you want a real challenge, reset your data and play through Act 1 with a low end weapon (now even more low end-ish.) 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Axu9eRu.gif[/img]

We also made it easier to see what a gun piece will do to your weapon by highlighting the stats that will improve or decline based on the piece you want to place.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VgdzKBX.gif[/img]

Plus we still added a few killer features...
[list]
    [*]Better joystick as mouse functions 
    [*]Updated gun colors
    [*]SFX updates (still more to come)
    [*]Weapon text updated,  avoids mouse
    [*]Map "dead exit" fix
    [*]Dialog updates
    [*]HD UI elements (mouse pointer, buttons, etc.)
[/list]

Enjoy this update!

notes.title: Weapon updates ahead for UPDATE 3
notes.content:
A quick preview of what we are working on for SKIPCHASER's third early access update.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/2Fq4lrv.gif[/img]

We've exposed more gun attributes, re-organized the workbench and fixed some display bugs with the Weapons Workbench. Now guns have 8 exposed attributes including:
[list]
    [*]Damage
    [*]Weight (Slow down when shooting penalty)
    [*]Accuracy
    [*]Fire Rate
    [*]Range (extra visibility)
    [*]Knockback
    [*]Recoil
    [*]Stun
[/list]
We are also working on a way to quickly visualize what a part affects in the status window and a parts elemental damage bonus.

notes.title: SKIPCHASER Early Access Update 2
notes.content:
So much to talk about. Update 2 is here and it’s got a bunch of new content and updates to existing functionality. Let’s just get to it...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/026aOnb.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Difficulty ramped up (reset your data to feel the effects)
[*]Three new missions, expanded endless mode
[*]Pistol blueprint (no run/gun penalty, low visibility, high cool rate)
[*]Story dialog re-worked (restart needed)
[*]Shooting robot enemy class
[*]Skeleton warlock enemy class
[*]Human grenadier class
[*]Landmine classes (bio, pyro, cryo)
[*]Trading cards!!!
[*]Variable grenade distance (called out in almost every “let’s play”)
[*]Enemy AI improvements (turrets, humans, bots)
[*]Pause, exit menu, terminal now combined into "super" terminal
[*]Bug fixes (various)
[*]And much, much more…
[/list]
As always, report bugs/issues as you find them and we’ll have another content update in 2 weeks. Thanks again for everyone supporting us in Early Access on Steam!

notes.title: Launch week nearly over, UPDATE 2 is coming
notes.content:
What a week. SKIPCHASER went live (albeit in early access), we presented and demoed at Hackfort (a digital conference in Boise, ID) and still managed to squeeze in some time to address feedback from plays, streams and reviews. 

UPDATE 2 is still a week away, but there are a few things I can confirm that will make the next build.

[list]
    [*]Variable grenade distance (called out in almost every stream)
    [*]Fixed bullets through walls (rare)
    [*]Removed "hiccup" on dialog showing
    [*]Enemy AI improvments (turrets, badguys, bots)
    [*]Pause, exit menu, terminal now combined into "super" terminal
    [*]Mission arrow outlined for visibility
    [*]Trading cards!!!
    [*]...and more stuff we can't confirm
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/H3YIZqa.gif[/img]

There are other things we've seen in streams that aren't "quick fixes" like variable difficulty, enhancing the story (believe me, there's more to it) and more enemy types. These things are on our roadmap, and as we progress they will make it in to these updates.

But for now, if you haven't picked it up, today is the last day of our 10% launch discount. So, hop on board if you are interested...

notes.title: SKIPCHASER EARC1 Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Our beta testers were really on the ball this weekend and provided some good, actionable feedback to make our launch even better.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/286a39c6722e40a3b649598f6c09ebadb3932ca1.png[/img]

We went straight to work and have these updates ready to go:
[list]
    [*]Random Grenade Error fixed
    [*]Badlands fade effect lessened
    [*]Pet and grenades now no longer auto trigger land mines,
    [*]Fixed “jumping over” landmines 
    [*]Outdoor levels no longer have multicolored floor tiles
    [*]Reduced font size in dialogs, various text updates (typos)
    [*]Enemies no longer fire from offscreen (but they will chase if they have LoS)
    [*]Minimum explosion radius upped to 192px — barrels much more dangerous
    [*]Fixed errand mission icon in middle of the map
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/286a39c6722e40a3b649598f6c09ebadb3932ca1.png[/img]

We went straight to work and have these updates ready to go:
[list]
    [*]Random Grenade Error fixed
    [*]Badlands fade effect lessened
    [*]Pet and grenades now no longer auto trigger land mines,
    [*]Fixed “jumping over” landmines 
    [*]Outdoor levels no longer have multicolored floor tiles
    [*]Reduced font size in dialogs, various text updates (typos)
    [*]Enemies no longer fire from offscreen (but they will chase if they have LoS)
    [*]Minimum explosion radius upped to 192px — barrels much more dangerous
    [*]Fixed errand mission icon in middle of the map
[/list]

notes.title: SKIPCHASER Early Access on 3/21
notes.content:
We are on track for a March 21st release of SKIPCHASER as an Early Access title. We’ve had a private beta for the past few months and that has been a HUGE help in getting some of the gameplay mechanics worked out and squishing those pesky bugs.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/979a5686cafc55793d5850e5d044ab984d36ee0b.gif[/img]

Today the closed beta will get the first of TWELVE early access updates—that will give us the weekend to play test and deliver any hot fixes needed before the live release on Tuesday.

What’s included in the Early Access release, you ask? Here it is by the numbers:
[list]
[*]5 complete missions from Act I
[*]30+ randomly generated levels
[*]8+ hand crafted maps including a boss battle
[*]5+ pages of story dialog
[*]2 weapon blueprints (Uzi, Rifle)
[*]40+ unlockable weapon upgrades
[*]4 enemy classes
[*]6+ NPC classes
[*]4 mission variations
[*]3 original songs by VXVX
[/list]
[b]Major updates from the last release[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved enemy AI
[*]Respawn options screen
[*]Terminal for dialog and help
[*]Elemental damage states
[*]Environmental interactions (switches, etc.)
[*]Missions 4 + 5
[*]Additional art assets
[*]Grenade capping
[*]Random chest drops
[*]Camera smoothing 
[*]Performance enhancements
[/list]

notes.title: SKIPCHASER Update Live
notes.content:
After our first pre-release version that crashed-and-burned we're back with a significant update that improves performance, solves some text issues and demos the first three missions of Act 1.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/5d8df1b07188fbc34102988fe09ac98224d7686c.gif[/img]

[b]New in the 2017.24.2c build[/b]
[list]
    [*]Numerous performance enhancements  
    [*]Coins no longer slow down the game when not collected
    [*]Kill the "bad guy" mission type added
    [*]More random map types (rogue-like and fenced)
    [*]Spacebase merged into space hub
    [*]Cave entrance updates
    [*]Weapon part unlock fix
    [*]Updated tilesets for random maps
    [*]UI tweaks for mouse and gamepad
    [*]More audio design
[/list]
See you at GDC!

notes.title: HOTFIX: Windows 7 Text
notes.content:
Over the weekend we installed a workaround for Windows 7 systems that weren't displaying text properly in UI and in-game dialog. This is just a workaround using a default font while we work with our SDK developers to get the proper fonts back in.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/5053ba4c0ee5c08e6bb73edd2872743c9694c4a2.png[/img]

We are also opening a bug submission forum if any of our private beta testers find anything we haven't.
